300716e368f56917a0c1.en: We use words to say how likely something is to happen.
300716e368f56917a0c1.id: Kita memakai kata-kata untuk menyatakan seberapa mungkin sesuatu terjadi.

0cc4ac1b3b1b48c7e87a.en: Certain means it will happen. Impossible means it can never happen.
0cc4ac1b3b1b48c7e87a.id: Certain berarti pasti terjadi. Impossible berarti tidak mungkin terjadi.

a4bf7e864b3dfd4ca924.en: Likely means it will probably happen. Unlikely means it probably will not.
a4bf7e864b3dfd4ca924.id: Likely berarti kemungkinan besar terjadi. Unlikely berarti kemungkinan besar tidak terjadi.

4b79fe52b8a72f5b4b6a.en: This bag has 7 apples and 1 pear. Taking an apple is likely, and taking the pear is unlikely.
4b79fe52b8a72f5b4b6a.id: Tas ini berisi 7 apel dan 1 pir. Mengambil apel itu likely, dan mengambil pir itu unlikely.
